View helper returning whether block.timestamp is still before endTime
ERC1155 receiver hook implemented by the auction contract

edges.reason: winning = msg.sender stores the caller-controlled address as current highest bidder
lastBid supplies the refund amount sent by winning.transfer
winning (the previous bidder) is the destination of the refund transfer
block.timestamp (now) determines the extended endTime in the anti-snipe branch
endTime is compared with now and reassigned when less than 15 minutes remain
lastBid is scaled by 110/100 to derive the required minimum bid
hausFee is derived from the local balance snapshot
hausFee is the amount forwarded to haus by the transfer
haus is the destination address of the fee transfer
seller is the destination address of the remaining balance transfer
token contract address is used to perform the ERC1155 transfer in end()
id identifies which ERC1155 token is sent to the winner
winning is the recipient of the ERC1155 asset in end()
token contract address is used to perform the ERC1155 transfer in pull()
id identifies which ERC1155 token is returned to the seller
seller is the recipient of the ERC1155 asset in pull()
live() derives its boolean result from block.timestamp versus endTime
lastBid is emitted in the Won event inside end()
winning is emitted in the Won event and used as transfer recipient inside end()
end() sets ended = true, latching the auction shut
pull() sets ended = true after returning the asset to the seller
constructor initialises lastBid to 0.3 ether
constructor computes endTime from startTime and length
constructor hardcodes startTime
constructor hardcodes the 24 hour auction length
constructor assigns the haus fee recipient
constructor assigns the seller address
constructor hardcodes the ERC1155 token id
constructor hardcodes the ERC1155 token contract address
endTime = startTime + length is an unchecked addition performed without SafeMath
bid() performs the refund transfer before updating lastBid and winning, violating checks-effects-interactions
end() executes the ERC1155 transfer to the winner
end() requires !live() to guarantee the auction is over
pull() requires !live() to guarantee the auction is over
pull() executes the ERC1155 transfer back to the seller
end() pays the haus fee after the asset transfer
end() sweeps the remaining balance to the seller
bid() gates entry with require(msg.sender == tx.origin, "no contracts")
msg.sender is checked against tx.origin and then becomes the recorded bidder
the mul/div minimum-bid requirement can revert or admit a weak bid
timestamp-driven endTime mutation inside bid() controls how long bidding stays open
native transfer to a malicious previous winner can re-enter bid() before state is finalised
safeTransferFrom invokes onERC1155Received on the winner contract, re-entering the auction during end()

normalization_plan.reason: end.balance is a transient local in end(), fully captured by the end() function node and only used to size the fee
end.hausFee is an intermediate value that flows directly into the haus.transfer unsafe operation
